titleEn: X Spaces: Abundance, AGI and the media (Peter Diamandis)

summaryEn: Peter Diamandis hosted Musk on an X Space discussing data-driven optimism, digital superintelligence, longevity, education and abundance heading into 2024.
summaryZh: 彼得·戴曼迪斯在一场 X Space 中主持了与马斯克的对谈，讨论了迈入 2024 年之际的数据驱动型乐观主义、数字超级智能、长寿、教育和富足。

segments.textEn: Following is a year's conversation I had with Elon Musk, arguably the greatest entrepreneur of our time, perhaps the greatest entrepreneur ever. During this conversation, which is called the Coming Age of Abundance, we talk about how technologies including AI and humanoid robotics are creating a world of abundance, uplifting humanity across food, water, energy, healthcare, education. We'll be talking about longevity, we'll be talking about AI.
